50 yrs old male patient with abdominal pain (Long Case) "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"50 year old male patient with abdominal pain.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online E logbook to discuss our patients' de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. This e-log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDate of admission: 16-01-2023.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECheif complaint: A 50 year old male, farmer by occupation came to the opd with the chief complaints of abdominal pain since 1 month\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back, then he developed abdominal pain in epigastric region and Right hypochondric region ,after consumption of food associated with bloating sensation since 1 yr and also associated chest pain ( retrosternal).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESqueezing type of pain, non radiating, increases after food consumption and after lifting heavy weights relieving on its own\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain lasts for 30 minutes during the episode\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o weight loss\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o vomitings\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o diarrhoea or constipation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o loss of appetite\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o blood in stools\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o burning micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o shortness of breath\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o regurgitation of food.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDaily Routine :-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient wakes up at 6 am brushes his teeth and takes bath by 7 am. Thn he has his breakfast ( rice or upma) , thn he goes to field for work by 8 am . He works there thn returns back by 1 pm, takes bath , thn has lunck ( 2 rotis and a bowel of rice with curry). Thn he stays in home only takes rest. He has his dinner by 8 pm (2 rotis n rice n daal ). He goes to sleep by 9 pm.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n \u003Ca "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"FEBRUARY 16 ,2022\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMamta Agrawal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERoll no. 42\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 30 yr old male patient who is painter by occupation since 10 yrs came to opd yesterday night with chief complaints of abdominal pain and repeated episodes of vomiting since 2 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 years back. Then he developed pain in abdomen at the epigastric region which is non radiating, intermittent , dragging like, moderate pain which is aggravated after having spicy food and when he drinks alchol on empty stomach in the morning and decreased with medication ( whose name he doesn't know and he didn't bring it to hospital)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe also had 2-3 episodes of vomiting which was non bilious non projectile and had food as it's contents.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe had similar complaints in the past 2 yrs for nearly 6-7 times. He had alcohol every day but stopped consuming alchol for the 3-4 months in between(religious reasons and no withdrawal) after which he was hospitalised was a month ago he had abdominal pain similar to the one he had before and 5-7 episodes of vomiting which was non bilious non projectile and food as it's contents and was blood tinged. - He was advised to have endoscopy which the patient didn't do and? medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe resumed his alchol after the discharge last time and he at present had similar abd pain and 8-10 episodes of vomiting without any blood contain.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis symptoms are aggravated generally after he drink in the morning on empty stomach.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe has mild intermediate tremors which doesnt interfere with his day to day activities.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe had no history of nausea, loss of appetite,diarrohea Or constipation.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe had no history of any seizures or sudden loss of consciousness.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe is not a known case of diabetes mellitus, hypertension, thyroid, asthma, TB, epilepsy, leprosy.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMother is a known hypertensive.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet - Mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite - Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep - Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements - Regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo known allergies\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions - alcohol (whisky) intake since 10 yrs (180 ml\/day) daily . Increased intake during holidays and weekends.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient started on alcohol because of occupational stress with half the quatity as of now and gradually the amount of intake increased.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHis general alcohol consuming routine\u0026nbsp; constitutes of having it in the evening and then after 2- 3 hours he has his dinner.
